prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1045; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, if that's okay. You can call me the claimant.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving through Katy, Texas, heading to a store on the other side of the intersection. I was turning left.

Q: What was the traffic like at the time?

A: Pretty steady. The light had turned yellow when I started my turn, and I think I was going a bit slow because I was waiting for a gap in oncoming cars.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not clearly. It came through the intersection from the opposite direction, and by the time I noticed it, it was already on top of me. I braked, but there wasn't time.

Q: Did you have any injuries at the scene?

A: I felt fine at first, just shaken up. But my neck started stiffening within a few hours, and the next morning I had pain running into my shoulders and headaches.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the accident?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same evening, and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then. The doctor said it looks like whiplash.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. Turning my head to the left is painful, and I can't sit at my desk for long without needing to stand up and stretch.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was trying to follow the rules and I'd like this handled fairly. I'm willing to provide my medical records.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
